clips.title: The story
paras: Nordrassil, the 'Crown of the Heavens,' is the original World Tree planted atop Mount Hyjal to shield the second Well of Eternity. Blessed by the Great Dragon Aspects, it granted the night elves ageless immortality and a deep connection to the Emerald Dream for ten thousand years. Its sacrifice during the climax of the Third War broke Archimonde's assault, leaving the tree wounded and the night elves mortal.

Ten thousand years ago, in the ashes of the Great Sundering, Illidan Stormrage cast vials of the original Well of Eternity into a mountaintop lake atop Mount Hyjal, birthing a new font of arcane power. To prevent this raw magic from corrupting the world or drawing the Burning Legion anew, the Dragon Aspect Alexstrasza planted an acorn from the Mother Tree, G'Hanir, directly over the waters. From it grew Nordrassil. The roots spread deep beneath Azeroth, sealing the Well's volatile energies and distributing gentle, life-giving vigor across the continents.
